nodes.rationale: Avoids requests to Google Fonts (GDPR, no consent banner) and supports performance budgets.

nodes.label: M7 Shop (Stripe, SmartBill e-Factura)
nodes.rationale: Deferred until her PFA is set up; content model keeps products/books/artworks separate so they can become sellable without migration.

nodes.label: WCAG 2.2 AA + performance budgets (LCP<2.5s, CLS<0.05, INP<200ms)
nodes.norm_label: wcag 2.2 aa + performance budgets (lcp<2.5s, cls<0.05, inp<200ms)

nodes.label: Butterfly flight and landing
nodes.rationale: Scroll-linked spline flight of her cover butterfly landing in the Fluture window; loaded after first paint to protect LCP.

nodes.label: Orb to universe page morph (View Transition)
nodes.norm_label: orb to universe page morph (view transition)
nodes.rationale: React <ViewTransition> shared element via Next experimental.viewTransition; plain navigation fallback where unsupported (Chromium 125+, Safari 18.2+, Firefox 144+).

nodes.label: prefers-reduced-motion fallback
nodes.rationale: Every motion item falls back to static or a fade; animations never hide content at rest (SEO + a11y).

nodes.label: M1 fixes from mockup review (eyebrow, font weight 600, 44px nav)
nodes.norm_label: m1 fixes from mockup review (eyebrow, font weight 600, 44px nav)

nodes.label: Next.js 16 + TypeScript + Tailwind v4 + Motion stack
nodes.norm_label: next.js 16 + typescript + tailwind v4 + motion stack
nodes.rationale: Next.js pinned to the newest version Payload supports, not the newest Next.js.

nodes.label: Orb focus grow (1.22 / 0.9 / 0.7)
nodes.rationale: Hover/keyboard focus on laptop, nearest mid-screen on phone; page leaves room below the map so the last world can reach the middle.

nodes.label: DESIGN.md (design system source of truth)
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth for tokens, type, spacing, components and motion; mapped into Tailwind v4 @theme.

nodes.label: afterChange revalidateTag on-demand revalidation
nodes.rationale: Static pages revalidated when Ramona publishes; no webhook needed because Payload runs inside the app.

nodes.label: Concept A: Poiana (meadow from the book cover)
nodes.norm_label: concept a: poiana (meadow from the book cover)
nodes.rationale: Visitor steps into the cover illustration instead of reading a brochure; refuses centered script hero over stock watercolor with three icon cards.

nodes.label: Banned line „Bine ai revenit acasă, puiule!”
nodes.norm_label: banned line „bine ai revenit acasa, puiule!”

nodes.label: Principle: honest „în curând” placeholders, never fabricate
nodes.norm_label: principle: honest „in curand” placeholders, never fabricate

nodes.label: Book cover: Fluturele dansator de step
nodes.author: Ramona Nichifor
nodes.norm_label: book cover: fluturele dansator de step
nodes.rationale: Watercolor children's book cover: pink-violet butterfly over sky-blue clouds and a lavender/pansy/poppy flower meadow; imprint 'Băiuț 2026' near bottom.

nodes.label: Flower meadow + sky watercolor palette (lavender, pink, sky blue)
nodes.norm_label: flower meadow + sky watercolor palette (lavender, pink, sky blue)
nodes.rationale: Meadow-and-sky imagery likely aligns with the chosen 'Poiana' (meadow) design direction and its sky motion.

nodes.label: Universuri page
nodes.rationale: Concept C orbs/pollen on a Poiana-palette sky; no connecting line so worlds drift freely.

nodes.label: At-Rest Rule
nodes.rationale: Every section readable with motion removed; content never depends on motion.

nodes.label: Orb drift
nodes.rationale: Incommensurate Lissajous periods so worlds never move in step; transform-only CSS for compositor 60fps.

nodes.label: Reduced-Motion Rule
nodes.rationale: Under prefers-reduced-motion all animations collapse to end state; nothing hidden.

nodes.label: Diacritics Rule
nodes.rationale: A face or weight that cannot render ă â î ș ț correctly does not ship.

nodes.label: Poveste font pairing
nodes.rationale: Final (2026-10-01) after comparing Newsreader+Commissioner, Literata+Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, Instrument Serif+Hanken Grotesk.

nodes.label: Cloudflare Turnstile
nodes.rationale: Invisible, more GDPR-friendly than reCAPTCHA.

nodes.label: 16+ consent checkbox
nodes.rationale: No separate age field (GDPR data minimisation); 16 is Romania's digital consent age.

nodes.label: Universe tints
nodes.rationale: Universe tints are content, not tokens; stored per universe in CMS.

nodes.label: GDPR privacy
nodes.rationale: No visitor cookies, cookie-free analytics, self-hosted fonts, contact form stores nothing.

nodes.label: Hosting decision
nodes.rationale: Open; default previews Netlify free + Neon free + R2; host-independent so moving later is cheap.

nodes.label: next-intl
nodes.rationale: RO at / with no prefix, EN at /en (localePrefix as-needed); localised diacritic-free slugs; UI strings in messages/*.json, not the CMS.

nodes.label: SEO strategy
nodes.rationale: Goal: first result for 'Ramona Nichifor'; no competing entity so achievable once indexed.

nodes.label: Home page
nodes.rationale: Port of the approved Poiana mockup; three audiences given equal weight via three path pills.

nodes.label: Merch / Shop Product
nodes.rationale: Shop is planned as a later milestone (M7); this asset likely previews future merch.

nodes.label: Handmade Ceramic Mug (berry on handle)
nodes.rationale: Photo of a hand-built, irregular sage/celadon glazed ceramic mug with crackle glaze and a sculpted deep-red berry on top of the handle, shot on linen fabric. Used as merch/product imagery in the mockup.

nodes.label: Empty central/left area for text overlay
nodes.norm_label: empty central/left area for text overlay
nodes.rationale: Large blank white area left of centre suggests the image is designed to sit behind headings/body copy.

nodes.label: Pastel palette: lavender, powder blue, blush pink
nodes.norm_label: pastel palette: lavender, powder blue, blush pink

nodes.label: Pastel wildflower sprays (lavender, pink blossoms)
nodes.rationale: Delicate watercolour flower branches (violets, cherry-like pink blossoms, lavender sprigs) clustered on the right edge and bottom-right corner, with a faint blue sprig bottom-left.

nodes.label: Watercolour wash background (wash.webp)
nodes.rationale: Portrait-format soft watercolour background: white/cream centre left open for content, pastel blue-lavender-pink washes and splatters at edges, vignette fading to transparent/dark at the borders. Used as a decorative page/section backdrop in the Poiana mockup.

nodes.label: Stepping Into the Cover
nodes.rationale: Site is the meadow from the cover of Fluturele dansator de step; visitor walks into the illustration rather than reading a brochure.

nodes.label: Poiana concept
nodes.rationale: Concept A chosen by the client.

nodes.label: Butterfly wing-flap animation (split-wing technique)
nodes.rationale: Wings exported separately so each can rotate/scaleX around the body axis to simulate flapping.

nodes.label: Watercolor pink-purple butterfly illustration (full)
nodes.rationale: Hand-painted watercolor butterfly with magenta/violet veins and pastel pink-peach-mint fill on transparent background; decorative brand motif for the illustrator's site.

nodes.label: Butterfly left wing (split sprite)
nodes.rationale: Left fore+hind wing cut from butterfly.webp, body edge at right side, likely pivot point for CSS flap animation.

nodes.label: Butterfly right wing (split sprite)
nodes.rationale: Right fore+hind wing cut from butterfly.webp, body edge at left side, likely pivot point for CSS flap animation.

nodes.label: Pastel violet/pink floral palette
nodes.rationale: Lavender, violet, rose, white, peach accents on soft green; likely informs Poiana color tokens.

nodes.label: Top fade into pale sky
nodes.rationale: Both images dissolve upward into white/pale blue so they blend into the page background or a sky layer.

nodes.label: Watercolor wildflower meadow (meadow.webp)
nodes.rationale: Soft watercolor illustration of pansies, cosmos, crocuses, lavender and a peach poppy in pink/violet/white, fading to white sky at the top; reads as a hero/foreground layer for the Poiana design.

nodes.label: Wide watercolor meadow strip (meadow-wide.webp)
nodes.rationale: Panoramic (~3:1) version of the same meadow, mirrored/repeated segments, top fades to white; suited as a full-width banner or footer/section-divider band.

nodes.label: Warm natural palette (off-white, brown, grey, sage green)
nodes.norm_label: warm natural palette (off-white, brown, grey, sage green)
nodes.rationale: Muted earthy tones in the photo may harmonize with the chosen Poiana (meadow) design direction.

nodes.label: Author portrait photo (portrait.webp)
nodes.rationale: Casual, warm, informal selfie-style vertical portrait (approx 9:16): woman with long brown hair, hand in hair, soft smile, grey knit sweater with sage-green fleece, plain off-white wall background, warm indoor lighting. Serves as the author/about photo for the Ramona Nichifor site mockup; approachable tone suits a children's author/illustrator brand.

nodes.label: Banned tagline rule
nodes.rationale: Never use 'Bine ai revenit acasă, puiule!' / 'Welcome home, baby'.

nodes.label: Native booking flow
nodes.rationale: Chosen over SaaS: Cal.com closing EU region 1 Nov 2026, Calendly lacks Romanian UI, Google booking page lacks payments/reminders; keeps design, language, EU data in-house.

nodes.label: Arch Window Rule
nodes.rationale: Universes/portraits/scenes framed as arch or orb; rectangles reserved for real objects (book, paintings).

nodes.label: No dark mode
nodes.rationale: One committed light world; dusk Universuri look not part of this world.

nodes.label: One Spark Rule
nodes.rationale: Magenta marks only what is alive or actionable now; two competing magenta things means one is wrong.

nodes.label: Paint edge filter
nodes.rationale: Watercolor edges from SVG displacement filters, not images.

nodes.label: Plum-Not-Black Rule
nodes.rationale: Plum type sits inside the watercolor instead of on top of it.

nodes.label: Plum Shadow Rule
nodes.rationale: Shadows always ink-tinted, never neutral black or hard-edged.

nodes.label: Soft Axis Rule
nodes.rationale: Every Fraunces setting carries SOFT 100; WONK 1 only on italic accent words.

nodes.label: afterChange revalidateTag hook
nodes.rationale: Pages static; afterChange hook revalidates on publish so no webhook needed.

nodes.label: Payload CMS
nodes.rationale: Chosen over Sanity (2026-10-01): shop likely later and Payload e-commerce plugin keeps it in same admin; MIT, free.
